subject: history
concept: Applying medieval world knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student designs a simple medieval settlement or castle layout, explaining their defensive and practical choices
exercise.abstract: Student explains their design choices in a short written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: design choices are connected to real medieval defensive/practical reasoning
misconception_flags: design choices have no connection to any real medieval defensive or practical factor

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
